google_rejected.title: Sign-in with an unapproved Google account
google_rejected.what: Someone tried to sign in to the shop admin with a Google account that is not an approved admin.
google_rejected.todo: No action is needed: the account got no access. If this keeps happening, secure the admins' Google accounts.

blocked.title: Passkey sign-in blocked
blocked.what: Passkey sign-in was blocked after several failed attempts.
blocked.todo: If this was not you, secure the admin's Google account. Another admin can clear the block in the admin area.

passkey_abandoned.title: Sign-in not completed with the passkey
passkey_abandoned.what: Someone signed in with an admin's Google account but did not finish the passkey step.
passkey_abandoned.todo: If this was not you, secure the admin's Google account.

admin_added.title: An admin was added
admin_added.what: A new admin was added to the shop.
admin_added.todo: If you did not expect this, check the admin list and remove anyone who should not be there.

admin_removed.title: An admin was removed
admin_removed.what: An admin was removed from the shop.
admin_removed.todo: If you did not expect this, check the admin list and contact the maintainer.

admin_reset.title: An admin's access was reset
admin_reset.what: An admin's access was reset by the maintainer.
admin_reset.todo: If you did not expect this, contact the maintainer.

passkey_added.title: A passkey was added
passkey_added.what: A passkey was added to an admin account.
passkey_added.todo: If you did not expect this, remove the passkey in the admin area and secure the Google account.

passkey_removed.title: A passkey was removed
passkey_removed.what: A passkey was removed from an admin account.
passkey_removed.todo: If you did not expect this, check the passkeys in the admin area.

recovery_used.title: A recovery code was used
recovery_used.what: A recovery code was used to sign in.
recovery_used.todo: If this was not you, secure the admin's Google account. A new passkey is waiting for approval by another admin.

recovery_regenerated.title: Recovery codes were regenerated
recovery_regenerated.what: An admin's recovery codes were regenerated.
recovery_regenerated.todo: If you did not expect this, secure the admin's Google account.

recovery_refused.title: A recovery request was refused
recovery_refused.what: A recovery request was refused because there is no other admin who could approve it.
recovery_refused.todo: If you did not ask for a recovery, secure the admin's Google account. If you did, contact the maintainer.

recovery_pending.title: A passkey is waiting for approval
recovery_pending.what: A new passkey created during a recovery is waiting for approval by another admin.
recovery_pending.todo: Sign in to the admin area, check that the request is from the admin you expect, and approve or reject it.

recovery_approved.title: A recovery passkey was approved
recovery_approved.what: A passkey created during a recovery was approved.
recovery_approved.todo: If you did not expect this, remove the passkey in the admin area.

recovery_rejected.title: A recovery passkey was rejected
recovery_rejected.what: A passkey created during a recovery was rejected.
recovery_rejected.todo: If you did not expect this, secure the admin's Google account.

order.title: Thank you for your order
order.intro: I've received your order. Here are all the details.
order.quoteNumber: When you transfer, write the order number {number}.
order.cancellationText: You may cancel a purchase as the law and the shop's cancellation policy allow. Pieces made specially for you fall under the exception in the law. Full details on the shipping, returns and cancellation page:

newOrder.subject: New order {number} – {shopName}
newOrder.title: A new order came in
newOrder.name: Name
newOrder.open: Open the order in the admin

paymentMismatch.subject: Payment amount problem – {shopName}
paymentMismatch.title: The payment doesn't match the order
paymentMismatch.what: A payment arrived in an amount or currency different from the order's. No order was created.
paymentMismatch.todo: Check the payment provider's dashboard, contact the customer and settle the payment (refund or top-up). The customer's details are kept in the system for 30 days. No card details are included.

second_payment.title: Possible double payment
second_payment.what: A further payment, in another transaction, arrived for an online payment that was already confirmed. No new order was created.
second_payment.todo: They probably paid twice: check the payment provider's dashboard and refund the extra payment if needed.

orphan_payment.title: Payment for an unknown order
orphan_payment.what: A payment arrived for an online checkout the system doesn't have (it expired or never existed). No order was created.
orphan_payment.todo: Probably a double payment: check the payment provider's dashboard and refund the payment if needed.

switched_offline.title: Paid on the site after switching to direct payment
switched_offline.what: The customer switched to direct payment and still paid on the payment page. Order {number} is awaiting payment.
switched_offline.todo: There are two ways. Keep the online payment, mark order {number} as paid and tell the customer not to pay directly. Or refund the online payment in the provider's dashboard. First check whether the customer already paid directly.

unverified_expiry.title: Couldn't check the status of an expired payment
unverified_expiry.what: An online checkout expired and I couldn't get its final status from the payment provider. It was deleted from the system.
unverified_expiry.todo: Check the payment provider's dashboard for a payment, and refund it if needed.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: The link may be old or the page may have moved. You can search here, or go to all pieces.

generic.title: Something went wrong
generic.text: I could not load this page. Please try again, and if it keeps happening, go back to the home page.
